assertion_analysis: limited_map_gate.py:73 booked.valid fails if the reference booking is invalid.
limited_map_gate.py:133 booking_valid fails if either mapped arm rejects its booked moments.
limited_map_gate.py:134 topology_valid fails if either mapped arm rejects topology.
limited_map_gate.py:151 positive span and analytic variation fail on a degenerate certificate or read.
limited_map_gate.py:183 and lobe_partition_gate.py:168 and test_lobe_partition.py:17 fail if binary64 is disabled.
test_lobe_partition.py:90 fails if the private one-slot fan emits the wrong live-row count; it does not call _whole_cell_rings.
test_lobe_partition.py:108 fails if the booked polynomial fan disagrees with an independent polygon closed form.
test_lobe_partition.py:136 fails if negative signs cease subtracting, but survives a shared quadrature bias because all terms use _ring_moments.
test_lobe_partition.py:138 fails if the signed uniform-density integral disagrees with independent polygon areas.

test_lobe_partition.py:171 fails if the production remainder returns invalid; :172 fails if the production cell fan covers the wrong counted polygon; :173 fails if the production remainder fails to equal that polygon when the lobe is empty.
test_lobe_partition.py:199 fails if the independent reference has other than three triangles; the count-equals-length half moves together because lobe_reference returns len(triangles).
test_lobe_partition.py:200-202 fail if the independent lobe integral disagrees with the separate polygon closed form, and the monkeypatch at :195 fails a restored call to current._normal_rings.

findings.text: blocking: the runner prints a skipped row or any deviation and returns success without checking 1e-12 or validity, so EXIT=0 cannot establish the quantitative partition gate.
blocking: the required 2,105-cell limited map row is unmeasured after CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY, so the all-three-sizes limited comparison in prompt.txt:105 is incomplete.

follow-on: signed and whole-minus-part are all computed by _ring_moments from the same test-supplied rings, so a shared quadrature bias leaves this assertion true; the independent constant-density check at :138 only covers that one density.
follow-on: this new runner duplicates the lobe and remainder reference comparison owned by lobe_reference_probe.py:1-20 instead of extending its carrier loop.
follow-on: _limited_context copies the map-context construction in fine_grid_convergence/context.py:89-163, creating a second owner for fixture assembly.
follow-on: the committed module declares itself a scratch probe outside the deliverable and adds an unused diagnostic surface.
